events.verdict: Vucevic (CHI) firms up in Brown's (BOS) path and marginal contact occurs as they come together during the screen.
LaVine (CHI) immediately slides his hand off of Tatum's (BOS) side and marginal contact occurs as they briefly engage during the screen.
Williams (CHI) moves alongside Brown's (BOS) path and marginal body contact occurs as they briefly come together during the drive.
Vucevic (CHI) legally contests Horford's (BOS) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
White (BOS) brings his arm forward and initiates contact with DeRozan's (CHI) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
LaVine (CHI) is moving alongside Brown's (BOS) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Williams (CHI) and Tatum (BOS) briefly engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs as the screen is set.
Smart (BOS) firms up in Williams' (CHI) path and does not deliver illegal contact during the screen.
Tatum (BOS) establishes himself in Dosunmu's (CHI) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Vucevic (CHI) rests an arm on Smart's (BOS) body and marginal contact occurs as he elevates to tap the loose ball away.
Williams (CHI) reaches for the loose ball and marginal contact occurs with Tatum's (BOS) arm, which does not affect Tatum's ability to secure the rebound and enter his shooting motion.
LaVine (CHI) initiates contact with Tatum's (BOS) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Williams (CHI) and Smart (BOS) jump alongside each other in pursuit of the loose ball and incidental contact occurs as they come together during the rebound.
Tatum (BOS) is moving slightly laterally alongside DeRozan (CHI) and marginal contact occurs as they come together at the end of the drive.
DeRozan (CHI) gathers the ball at the end of his drive on two feet and then splits them.
Tatum (BOS) makes clean ball contact to dislodge it from Williams (CHI) during Williams' shot attempt near the rim. Any follow-through contact after the dislodge is deemed incidental.
DeRozan (CHI) reaches for the loose ball as Tatum (BOS) regains control and marginal contact occurs before Tatum makes his intended pass.
LaVine (CHI) grabs and pulls Brown's (BOS) jersey away from his body off-ball, affecting Brown's FOM while the pass is in the air.
Brown (BOS) and LaVine (CHI) briefly come together and incidental contact occurs during their pursuit of the loose ball.
Tatum (BOS) makes clean contact with the ball on his dislodge attempt after LaVine (CHI) gains possession of the loose ball.
Williams (CHI) turns into and delivers body contact to Tatum (BOS), which affects Tatum's SQBR.
Brogdon (BOS) is not vertical when he makes contact with DeRozan's (CHI) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) extends his arm into Brogdon's (BOS) path and makes contact with his face, which affects Brogdon's SQBR.
Brown (BOS) is moving alongside LaVine's (CHI) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together at the end of the drive.
LaVine (CHI) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes more than two steps before elevating to pass.
Dosunmu (CHI) commits a take foul on Brogdon (BOS). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
